title: Synthesis and Structure of a New Layered Organic-inorganic Hybrid Compound Containing Unique Chain of CuI
abstract: Abstract                   Synthesis and X-ray crystal structure of a novel iodocuprate(I) compound (C16H19N2)2  ∞1[Cu5I7] was reported. The unique CuI chains which result from the tetrahedron CuI4 and pseudo trigonal pyramid CuI3 through sharing edge are presented in the iodocuprate(I).
